answer_1.quote: In this work, we present PRIMERA a pre-trained model for multi-document summarization... We conduct extensive experiments on 6 multidocument summarization datasets from 3 different domains.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE scores (R-1, -2, and -L), which are the standard evaluation metrics, to evaluate the downstream task of multi-document summarization.

answer_4.quote: Three annotators are hired to do both Pyramid Evaluation and Fluency evaluation... they are asked to find all the covered SCUs for each summary, and score the fluency in terms of Grammaticality, Referential clarity and Structure & Coherence.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assess content quality using Pyramid Evaluation (SCU recall/precision/F1) and fluency using DUC guidelines (grammaticality, referential clarity, structure & coherence).
